oilField.name: Conventional oil field
oilField.note: Recoverable reserves of an oil field (1 unit = 1 barrel of crude). Scales with area and does not recover.

oreDeposit.name: Open-pit metal deposit
oreDeposit.note: Tonnage of a deposit that can be mined open-pit (1 unit = 1 kg). Scales with area and does not recover.

river.name: River
river.note: A water source defined by its flow (1 unit = 1 m³). The cap is 30 days of withdrawable water and refills every epoch.

lake.name: Lake / reservoir
lake.note: Storage proportional to area, refilled by inflow (1 unit = 1 m³). Drawing more than the inflow lowers the water level.

groundwater.name: Groundwater
groundwater.note: Aquifer storage proportional to area with slow recharge from rainfall (1 unit = 1 m³). Once over-pumped, it takes many years to recover.

nonmetallicDeposit.name: Nonmetallic mineral deposit
nonmetallicDeposit.note: Gravel, limestone, and silica sand reserves (1 unit = 1 kg). Scales with area and does not recover.

summary.needsShape: Draw the shape to fill in a reserve based on its area
